messages.content: I booked everything from the selected screens. Can we verify it all and put the confirmation numbers, deadlines, seats, and Tuesday timing in one itinerary?
Yes. Send me the confirmation details shown for the flights, both hotels, and the car. Please include the exact totals and any cancellation wording that changed at checkout.

Flights are Delta confirmation H7Q4LM: MSP to SAV Thursday October 17, 1:25 p.m. to 7:18 p.m. through Atlanta, then SAV to MSP Tuesday October 22, 4:05 p.m. to 8:20 p.m., also through Atlanta. Two economy tickets plus one shared checked bag came to $1,076.
Recorded. Are seats available on all four segments, and what are the individual flight times through Atlanta?

Thursday is MSP 1:25 to ATL 4:58, then ATL 6:05 to SAV 7:18. Tuesday is SAV 4:05 to ATL 5:18, then ATL 6:25 to MSP 8:20. I can choose 18A and 18B on the first leg, 14A and 14B to Savannah, 16A and 16B out of Savannah, and 20A and 20B on the last leg.
Those pairs keep you together on every segment. Assign 18A/18B, 14A/14B, 16A/16B, and 20A/20B in that order, then confirm the seat map shows them as saved rather than merely selected.

Done. All eight show assigned. Savannah hotel is confirmation SAV48271, Thursday through Saturday, $542.64 total. It now says cancel by 6:00 p.m. Central on Monday October 14, which is earlier than the date we had before.
Use the checkout confirmation as controlling: Monday, October 14 at 6:00 p.m. Central. That is three days before arrival. What does the Tybee confirmation show?
Tybee is TYB90633, Saturday through Tuesday, $834.48 with tax. Free cancellation ends at 4:00 p.m. Eastern on Saturday October 12. After that the full stay is charged.

Recorded: October 12 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern, with the full-stay penalty afterward. That is the first deadline. Please send the rental confirmation and whether the downtown pickup and airport return are both correct.
Rental is R8K3117, compact car, downtown Savannah Saturday at 10:00 a.m. and SAV airport Tuesday at 3:30 p.m. Total is $318, payable at pickup. No prepayment.

That matches the planned one-way rental. On Saturday, check out around 9:15 a.m., leave the bags with the hotel, walk or rideshare to the downtown counter for the 10:00 a.m. pickup, then return to the loading area for the luggage before driving to Tybee.
For Tuesday, what time should we actually leave Tybee? I don’t want the 3:30 car-return time to make the 4:05 flight too tight.

Treat 3:30 p.m. as the reservation endpoint, not the target return. Leave Tybee by 12:30 p.m. The drive is commonly about 35 to 50 minutes, but allow an hour for traffic. Refuel near the airport around 1:30 p.m., reach rental return by 1:50 p.m., and aim to enter the terminal by 2:10 p.m. That gives you about 1 hour 55 minutes before departure to check the shared bag and clear security.
Good. Include the Thursday arrival transfer and give me the complete chronological version with the total.

Saturday, October 12: Tybee cancellation deadline at 4:00 p.m. Eastern. Monday, October 14: Savannah cancellation deadline at 6:00 p.m. Central. Thursday, October 17: depart MSP at 1:25 p.m., connect in Atlanta from 4:58 to 6:05 p.m., arrive SAV at 7:18 p.m., collect the shared checked bag, and take the estimated $45 rideshare to the historic district; stay under hotel confirmation SAV48271. Friday, October 18: second Savannah night. Saturday, October 19: check out about 9:15 a.m., store luggage, pick up the compact at 10:00 a.m. under R8K3117, retrieve the bags from the loading area, and drive to Tybee; begin the three-night stay under TYB90633. Sunday and Monday, October 20-21: Tybee. Tuesday, October 22: leave by 12:30 p.m., allow up to an hour to the airport area, refuel around 1:30 p.m., return the car near 1:50 p.m., and target the SAV terminal by 2:10 p.m. Depart at 4:05 p.m., connect in Atlanta from 5:18 to 6:25 p.m., and arrive MSP at 8:20 p.m. Flight confirmation is H7Q4LM; seats are 18A/18B, 14A/14B, 16A/16B, and 20A/20B. Confirmed transportation and lodging total $2,816.12: flights and bag $1,076, Savannah $542.64, Tybee $834.48, rental $318, and estimated arrival rideshare $45. With the separate $90 fuel or incidental-parking allowance, the working trip total is $2,906.12, leaving $893.88 under the $3,800 ceiling.
